in_hebrew.name: Warner
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Warner הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Warner has its origin in Old English from the word weard, which means guard or protector. This name was often given to those who held a position of responsibility and protection, such as a soldier, a knight, or a guardian of a community. In Christian tradition, Warner can also be seen as a symbol of God's protection and guidance.
